video_title: Hornets at Wizards: Moussa Diabate Postgame Media Availability | 10/30/2026

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on Charlotte's offensive struggles and missed shots
quotes.excerpt: I think it comes down to not making shots, right. We are getting the shots open.
quotes.quote: I think it comes down to not making shots, right. We are getting the shots open. We had the opportunities to make it, it just didn't happen for us. I think that was the biggest thing I've seen really. We were aggressive on defense. What was the score? Hold on. What did they finish with? 95 points. I mean, right now it's like we are playing amazing defense, we are just not making shots. I think that's what it really came down to.
quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate says the Hornets are playing amazing defense but are struggling to convert on offense. He noted that the team is getting open looks but simply not making shots.

structured.context: Moussa Diabate discusses the Hornets' offensive performance and missed shots following their game against the Wizards.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on Hornets' defensive communication and physicality
quotes.excerpt: Our communication, being aggressive on defense, being physical, that's been our bread and butter.
quotes.quote: Our communication, being aggressive on defense, being physical, that's been our bread and butter. And you know, just limit them to one shot. I think we are trying as much as we can to give them only one opportunity.
quotes.social_post: Moussa Diabate emphasizes that defensive communication and physicality remain the bread and butter for this Hornets team as they look to limit opponents to one shot per possession.

structured.context: Moussa Diabate explains the importance of defensive communication and physicality as the team's core identity.

quotes.speaker: Moussa Diabate
quotes.summary_phrase: Moussa Diabate on moving forward after back-to-back losses
quotes.excerpt: Obviously it wasn't our best night, but flush it down. We got one more game tomorrow.
quotes.quote: Obviously it wasn't our best night, but flush it down. We got one more game tomorrow. That's going to be another great opportunity to come back and get better.
quotes.social_post: After back to back losses Moussa Diabate says the team is ready to flush it down and focus on the next opportunity to get better in tomorrow night's game.

structured.context: Moussa Diabate reflects on the team's mindset following back-to-back losses and looks ahead to the next game.
